meta.title: Lenox Restaurant-Bar Gitega | 800-Seat Reception Hall, Restaurant & Bar
meta.description: Restaurant, bar and 800-seat reception hall in Gitega, NYABIHARAGE district. African and international cuisine, live entertainment, 50-space parking, 24/7 security.

hero.title: The table and the hall that make Gitega's grandest days
hero.lead: A welcoming venue for your events and ceremonies. Flavorful cuisine, refined drinks, warm atmosphere.
hero.proof: 800+ guests · 50+ parking spaces · 24/7 security · Free Wi-Fi

about.title: About Lenox
about.lead: Lenox Restaurant-Bar is your premier destination in Gitega for an exceptional culinary experience and unforgettable moments.
about.story_p1: Located in the heart of Gitega in the NYABIHARAGE district, Lenox Restaurant-Bar is an establishment that blends tradition and modernity. We are committed to offering a unique gastronomic experience in a warm and convivial atmosphere.
about.story_p2: Our passionate team works every day to bring you flavorful dishes, quality drinks, and exceptional services for all your events.

highlights.cuisine_body: Delicious breakfasts, lunches and dinners featuring local and international specialties.
highlights.shows_body: Live music, karaoke, and band performances to liven up your evenings.
highlights.events_body: Reception hall for 800+ people, ideal for weddings and conferences.
highlights.wifi_body: High-speed internet available for all guests.
